case.summary: Case CASE-017 (Card SC-03017-K947): The case was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.81 on transaction 4012164 ($220.38 domestic) [EV-46cf9f5c]. Investigation revealed three online transactions within 48 hours on card SC-03017-K947 [EV-fe797bed], with a proxy/anonymous connection from Spain used for the flagged transaction [EV-b8fe6461]. The device profile was linked to one prior confirmed fraud case [EV-c576468b], and the customer had one prior fraud case CC-4318 [EV-fcb16281]. Customer confirmed they did not make the purchases and retained physical card possession [EV-fca2852d]. Pattern analysis retrieved six prior card-not-present fraud cases [EV-358e0791]. Total exposure across three transactions (4012164, 4012165, 4012166) was $586.82.
